source: IGN Final Fantasy V wiki (local copy) + FINAL FANTASY V PR master data

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: The very first Chest in the game is hidden in the Tycoon Meteorite area, in the clearing where you rescue Lenna from two Goblins. There, look for a hidden path you can walk through South-East of the Meteorite, through the trees. You’ll go East a bit, then South. The Chest will be visible at the end. The item inside is a Phoenix Down, which can be used to revive a KO’s party member and restores their health by a quarter of their maximum HP. They’re incredibly valuable, especially since they cost 1,000 gil to buy from a store.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: On the second floor of the Cave. After the scene with the Pirate, head Left to find it at the top of the ledge. The item inside is a Leather Cap, which raises your Defense, Magic Defense and Weight by 1.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is found in a secret room of the Pirates’ Hideout. To return here, enter via the Cave to the South just as you did in the main story, and retrace your steps into the Hideout. From the Southern entrance of the Hideout part of the cave, head West and interact with the skull in the wall, to the left of the pirate flag. This will open a door elsewhere in the Hideout. Head North a bit and then go through the door to the left, directly across from the dock. You’ll emerge in a small room. If you hit the skull switch earlier, you can head North through the doorway into a second room with three chests! Chest 1 will be the left-hand chest, and contains a Tent.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: In the same room as Chest 1. This will be the middle chest, and contains an Ether.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: In the same room as Chest 1. This will be the right-hand chest, and contains 300 gil.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is located on the Western side of the Wind Shrine’s second floor. When you come up the stairs from the first floor, head all the way West (past the door in the middle of the floor) to find the Chest just to the South. The Chest contains a Tent, which allows you to restore the HP and MP of the entire party by 1,000 each. However, it can only be used at a Save Point or the World Map.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: While this Chest is located on the third floor of the Wind Shrine, you get to it via a side-door of the second floor. After you pass through the small room with the Save Point in it, you’ll appear in the Southern part of the second floor. Here, head right and then up through the door. You’ll arrive in a tiny room of the third floor, with this Chest sitting in the corner.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: Found just before you face the Wing Raptor boss on the third floor of the Wind Shrine. When you find the Griffon-like Wing Raptor guarding the middle door of the third floor, divert through the door to the far left. You’ll enter a tiny room with this Chest in the corner. The item inside is a Broadsword, which deals damaged based on the welder's Strength. It can be equipped Freelancers, Knights, Mystic Knights and Blue / Red Mages.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: This Chest is a hidden one in the fourth floor of the Wind Shrine. When you arrive, head to the South-East corner of the floor, where you’ll find a square pillar. What you’ll need to do is go to the right-hand tile in front of it, then go South. A secret passage will be revealed, letting you go East towards the Chest! The item inside is a Staff, which can be used by Freelancers, White / Red / Time Mages, Chemists, and Mimes. It deals damage based on the wielders strength, but it will vary between half or 150%. Additionally, it will ignore 75% of the target’s Defense.

entries.label: Item 1
entries.guide: This item can be found on the Eastern side of town. From the entrance to town, follow the path right to the Eastern side of the Inn. Here, slip North along the right-hand side of the building to find a barrel. Interact with it to get 150 Gil!

entries.label: Item 2
entries.guide: This item is found in the Greenhorn’s Club, which is the building in the South-West corner of Tule. Head inside and answer “Yes” to the receptionist to be let in. In the North-West corner of the room is a box: open it to get a Tent!

entries.label: Item 3
entries.guide: This item is found in the Greenhorn’s Club, which is the building in the South-West corner of Tule. Head inside and answer “Yes” to the receptionist to be let in. In the North-West corner of the room is a barrel: open it to get a Phoenix Down!

entries.label: Item 4
entries.guide: This item is found in the Greenhorn’s Club, which is the building in the South-West corner of Tule. Head inside and answer “Yes” to the receptionist to be let in. In the North-West corner of the room is a pot: open it to get a Potion!

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is found in the Greenhorn’s Club, which is the building in the South-West corner of Tule. Head inside and answer “Yes” to the receptionist to be let in. Once there, look for the man in green just left of the receptionist. You can head through the wall just above him to find a secret passage. If you’re having trouble finding it, change one of your party members to the Thief job, and it will automatically be revealed. The passage will lead up to the North-West corner of the room (normally blocked by another man in green). This Chest will be the one on the left, and contains an Ether. Ethers will restore up to 40 MP to the recipient!

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: This Chest is found in the Greenhorn’s Club, which is the building in the South-West corner of Tule. Head inside and answer “Yes” to the receptionist to be let in. Once there, look for the man in green just left of the receptionist. You can head through the wall just above him to find a secret passage. If you’re having trouble finding it, change one of your party members to the Thief job, and it will automatically be revealed. The passage will lead up to the North-West corner of the room (normally blocked by another man in green). This Chest will be the one on the right, and contains 100 Gil.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: This Chest is found in the Greenhorn’s Club, which is the building in the South-West corner of Tule. Head inside and answer “Yes” to the receptionist to be let in. Head to the North end of the room and go upstairs to the upper level. In the South-West corner will be a Chest: open it, and you’ll have to fight a Goblin for its contents! Once you defeat it, you’ll get Leather Shoes!

entries.label: Item 5
entries.guide: This Item is found among the boxes and barrels at the Southern end of the river bridge that leads up to Rok’s House. Check the barrel closest to the river bridge to get a Potion!

entries.label: Item 6
entries.guide: This Item is found among the boxes and barrels at the Southern end of the river bridge that leads up to Rok’s House. Check the North-Western box to get a Tent!

entries.label: Item 0
entries.guide: This listing is technically two Items, however they're mutually exclusive, meaning you cannot get both. To find it, head anti-clockwise around the Pub, then stand behind the small building to the South of it. The idea here is that you'll walk through the building and into the forest, which acts like a maze. You can either use the map above, or the directions below. It's not the most efficient way to get there, but it is the simplest! To use them, walk in the direction until your character stops, then use the next direction! When you follow these steps correctly, you'll appear in a clearing with a robed man and two wooden boxes. He lets you pick a weapon from one of them, so read below to figure out which one you want to use:

locations.name: Torna Canal
missables: One-time area on the boat trip north: the two battles here are the only chance to record Sucker and Octokraken.

locations.name: Ship Graveyard
missables: Leave the area and come back after clearing it, then win one more battle: the achievement check is known to miss the first pass.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is cleverly hidden at the start of the Ship Graveyard level. From Faris’ ship, head East across the fallen mast, then South down the wooden plank. Jump onto the rock just South of it and wait a moment: a series of rocks will appear out of the water and you’ll jump along them to the Chest! The Chest will contain a Flail, which is actually related to Staffs and thus can be held by Freelancers, White / Red / Time Mages, Chemists and Mimes. If you give this to a character, put them in the back of the formation, as this allows the Flail to be used with full power.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: Found inside the Sunken Shipwreck. From Faris’ ship, head East across the mast, then North to the keel end of a ship split in two. There’ll be a staircase here to the rear deck: enter the door to the right of it to enter the captain’s quarters, then down the stairs on the opposite side of the room. In this lower decks area, notice the doorway in the middle of this area with light coming out of it. Head through to enter a tiny room with this Chest in it.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: In the lower decks of the Sunken Shipwreck, where you head underwater. After wading through the water and going down the stairs to the lowest decks, head down the stairs and open the chest marked with a skull and crossbones to get 990 Gil.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: Found in the Sunken Shipwreck you explore. After first wading into the water and going downstairs, head South down the staircase, then North up another, shorter staircase. Continue North and head through the Northern-most door to enter a new room. Here, you should see the Chest visible through a hole in the floor. You can reach it by heading down the staircase South-West of the entry door, then heading North.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: Found inside the Sunken Shipwreck after you explore underwater. You’ll head into the water, go downstairs, then go South down a staircase and then North up another staircase out of the water. Here will be two doors: go through the Southern door with the light spilling through it. Continue through this next room, going South down the staircase and then using the stairs in the South-East corner to go down a floor. In this thin room, head up the right-hand side to find the Chest!

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: Inside the second Sunken Shipwreck, the one where you have to use Jump prompts to reach. Head inside by using the door next to the stairs (same method as the first Sunken Shipwreck) to enter a room with the World Map. Continue down the stairs in the South-East corner to find a room with three Chests. The left-hand Chest will contain an Antidote, which will remove the Poison status effect on whoever it’s used on.

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: Inside the second Sunken Shipwreck, the one where you have to use Jump prompts to reach. Head inside by using the door next to the stairs (same method as the first Sunken Shipwreck) to enter a room with the World Map. Continue down the stairs in the South-East corner to find a room with three Chests. The left-hand Chest will contain an Antidote

entries.label: Chest 8
entries.guide: Inside the second Sunken Shipwreck, the one where you have to use Jump prompts to reach. Head inside by using the door next to the stairs (same method as the first Sunken Shipwreck) to enter a room with the World Map. Continue down the stairs in the South-East corner to find a room with three Chests. The left-hand Chest will contain a Phoenix Down.

locations.name: Carwen
missables: Only three of the town's four items are reachable in World 1.
Later on, Mighty Guard is taught by the Stingray in the sea battle off the coast, and Syldra joins straight after it.

entries.label: Item 1
entries.guide: Located in the center of the town, just North of the general Items store. Here you’ll find a line of five barrels: check the second barrel from the left to get an Antidote!

entries.label: Item 2
entries.guide: Found in a rather cheeky spot. Head to the docks on the East side of town, then look for some crates on the Southern end of the docks. Walk between them, then zig-zag West and South to go through a hidden route. You’ll emerge underneath an archway overlooking the water. Check the crate in this arch to find a Frost Rod! The Frost Rod increases the power of Ice attacks by 50%. If used as an item, it will cast Blizzaga and then break. It can be used by Freelancers, Black / Time / Blue / Red Mages, Summoners and Mimes.

entries.label: Item 3
entries.guide: Found in Carwen’s pub, which is the building in the North-East corner of the town. Enter it, then head for the South-West corner of the main dining area. There’s a secret passage here leading to a side-room to the West. Head North to the kitchen, then check the Northern-most pot for 1,000 Gil!

locations.name: North Mountain
missables: In the Magissa fight, hold back until she summons Forza and beat it before the battle ends.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: Found inside the cave you explore in North Mountain. From the entrance, head West and then South down the path, where the Chest will be waiting at the end with a Phoenix Down.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: Also found inside the cave you explore in North Mountain. From the entrance, head North, then West to the intersection: go South from here to find this Chest at the dead-end. This Chest contains a Gold Needle, which cures the target of the Petrify status effect.

entries.label: Item 1
entries.guide: Found in the interior section of the castle, which connects to the Western door of the main hall on the way to the sleeping quarters. Between the two Southern exits of this room are two pots and a barrel. Check the right-hand pot for a Hi-Potion, which restores 500 HP!

entries.label: Item 2
entries.guide: Found from the main hall of Castle Tycoon where Lenna first met with the Chancellor. Here, take the Eastern exit to briefly go outside; continue North to enter a library. Check the pot to the right of the entry door to find an Elixir.

entries.label: Item 3
entries.guide: Found from the main hall of Castle Tycoon where Lenna first met with the Chancellor. Here, take the Eastern exit to briefly go outside; continue North to enter a library. Check the barrel to the right of the entry door to find a Cottage. The Cottage will fully restore the HP and MP of the entire party, but it can only be used at Save Points or on the World Map.

entries.label: Item 4
entries.guide: Found from the main hall of Castle Tycoon where Lenna first met with the Chancellor. Here, take the Eastern exit to briefly go outside; continue North to enter a library. Check the closest barrel in the South-West corner of the room to find a Phoenix Down.

entries.label: Item 5
entries.guide: Found from the main hall of Castle Tycoon where Lenna first met with the Chancellor. Here, take the Eastern exit to briefly go outside; continue North to enter a library. Check the farthest barrel in the South-West corner of the room to find an Elixir. The Elixir will fully restore the HP and MP of the target it’s used on.

entries.label: Item 6
entries.guide: Found from the main hall of Castle Tycoon where Lenna first met with the Chancellor. Here, head North into the Throne Room, then take the North-Eastern door. Continue through these rooms until you reach the fourth floor, a room with pots, two columns and some stairs in the middle. Check the Eastern-most pot for a Maiden’s Kiss, which removes the Toad status effect from whoever it’s used on.

entries.label: Item 7
entries.guide: Found from the main hall of Castle Tycoon where Lenna first met with the Chancellor. Here, head North into the Throne Room, then take the North-Eastern door. Continue through these rooms until you reach the fourth floor, a room with pots, two columns and some stairs in the middle. Check the pot on the Southern wall that’s farthest East of the Southern exit to find a Phoenix Down.

entries.label: Item 8
entries.guide: Found from the main hall of Castle Tycoon where Lenna first met with the Chancellor. Here, head North into the Throne Room, then take the North-Eastern door. Continue through these rooms until you reach the fourth floor, a room with pots, two columns and some stairs in the middle. Check the pot on the Southern wall just East of the Southern exit to find an Elixir.

entries.label: Item 9
entries.guide: Found from the main hall of Castle Tycoon where Lenna first met with the Chancellor. Here, head North into the Throne Room, then take the North-Eastern door. Continue through these rooms until you reach the fourth floor, a room with pots, two columns and some stairs in the middle. Check the pot just West of the Southern exit to find an Ether.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: Found from the front courtyard of Castle Tycoon, but only after you’ve talked with the Chancellor and rested for the night. Once you’ve done this, return to the courtyard and head down the Western stairs, then North through the archway and through the door at the end of this path to enter the Storeroom. Inside, locate the switch on the North wall to reveal a secret passage. Talk to the Chancellor at the end to get a Healing Staff. The Healing Staff has +2 Magic, and will cast Cura when attacking a target, meaning it will deal damage against undead targets. It can be used by Freelancers, White / Time / Red Mages, Chemists and Mimes.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: Found from the front courtyard of Castle Tycoon, but only after you’ve talked with the Chancellor and rested for the night. Once you’ve done this, return to the courtyard and head down the Western stairs, then North through the archway and through the door at the end of this path to enter the Storeroom. Inside, locate the switch on the North wall to reveal a secret passage. Open the right-hand Chest to get Ashura. Ashura is a Katana, meaning it can only be used by Freelancers and Samurais. It has +42 attack, and has a 12% chance of landing a critical hit.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: Found from the front courtyard of Castle Tycoon, but only after you’ve talked with the Chancellor and rested for the night. Once you’ve done this, return to the courtyard and head down the Western stairs, then North through the archway and through the door at the end of this path to enter the Storeroom. Inside, locate the switch on the North wall to reveal a secret passage. Open the front-left Chest to get a Shuriken. The Shuriken is a throwing item, meaning it can only be used by Ninjas. It has 50 Attack.

locations.name: Castle Walse
missables: Do not free Lone Wolf: he empties the castle chests.
Shiva waits in the Water Tower behind the waterfall.

entries.label: Item 1
entries.guide: This Item is found in Castle Walse’s Storeroom. To get here, head to the entry hall of the castle, then take the double doors in the North-Eastern corner. Here, take the small stairs in the South-Eastern corner to arrive in the Storeroom. Search the barrel on the Western wall to find a Tent!

entries.label: Item 2
entries.guide: This Item is found in Castle Walse’s Storeroom. To get here, head to the entry hall of the castle, then take the double doors in the North-Eastern corner. Here, take the small stairs in the South-Eastern corner to arrive in the Storeroom. Search the crate next to the Northern window to find 490 gil!

entries.label: Item 3
entries.guide: This Item is found in Castle Walse’s Storeroom. To get here, head to the entry hall of the castle, then take the double doors in the North-Eastern corner. Here, take the small stairs in the South-Eastern corner to arrive in the Storeroom. Search the barrel on the Eastern wall to find a Phoenix Down!

entries.label: Item 4
entries.guide: This item is in the basement of Castle Walse. You can get here by going to the entry hall and going down the stairs to the East. Here, take the doors in the North-East corner and go down the next stairs to enter the basement. Follow the path here to the end and take the right-hand door. The gil will be in the left-hand pot.

entries.label: Item 5
entries.guide: This item is in the basement of Castle Walse. You can get here by going to the entry hall and going down the stairs to the East. Here, take the doors in the North-East corner and go down the next stairs to enter the basement. Follow the path here to the end and take the right-hand door. The middle pot will contain Speed, which increases the speed of a battle to 5. This is equivalent to “6” or “Very Fast” in the Configuration menu, so if you’ve already done that then this spell will have no effect.

entries.label: Item 6
entries.guide: This item is in the basement of Castle Walse. You can get here by going to the entry hall and going down the stairs to the East. Here, take the doors in the North-East corner and go down the next stairs to enter the basement. Follow the path here to the end and take the right-hand door. The gil will be in the right-hand pot.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This item is in the basement of Castle Walse. You can get here by going to the entry hall and going down the stairs to the East. Here, take the doors in the North-East corner and go down the next stairs to enter the basement. Follow the path here to the end and take the left-hand hoor, then open the Chest in the North-West corner to get the Elven Mantle.

locations.name: Tower of Walse
missables: One-time area: four chests, Pond's Chorus from the Elf Toad, and three bestiary entries that appear nowhere else.
In the merged world the sunken tower holds the Mime job.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is on the fifth floor of the Tower of Walse, however it’s accessed via a hidden route on the fourth floor, where you find King Walse. Take the steps next to him to enter the left-hand pool, then interact with the viny column to climb up to a side area of 5F. The Chest will be directly North. The Silk Robe is a piece of Chest Armor. While it has no special effects, it has +15 Magic Evasion.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: Also located on the fifth floor, but easier to access. From the Save Point in the middle of the room, head East and then North to find it! It’ll have a Maiden’s Kiss inside.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: Located on the ninth floor of the tower, but accessed from the 8th, the one with three vines to climb up out of the water. In this room, climb up the North-Western vines to get to a side area of the 9th floor. Head South-West to find the Chest at the end. The Silver Armlet inside gives +5 Magic Evasion, and can be equipped by Freelancers, Monks, Thieves, Ninjas, Rangers, White / Black / Red / Blue / Time Mages, Beastmasters, Chemists, Geomancers, Bards, Dancers and Mimes. That’s a lot!

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: Located on the ninth floor of the tower, but accessed from the 8th, the one with three vines to climb up out of the water. In this room, climb up the North-Eastern vines to get to the ninth floor. Here, head South-East to find the Chest at the end, with an Ether inside.

locations.name: Walse
missables: Buy the Iron Shield and the Kenpo Gi from the shop while you are here.
Chocobo, Sylph and Remora are all picked up around Walse.

entries.label: Item 1
entries.guide: The only thing to find in Walse is inside the house in the South-Eastern corner of town, which you can get to by going down the stairs to the West of the entrance to town. From there head up the stairs to the West. Inside, head to the South-East corner of the house to find the Silver Specs in the white pot. Silver Specs will prevent the wearer from getting the Darkness status ailment.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: Found when you first enter the metal engine room of the Fire-Powered Ship. From the entrance, head North through the silver door to enter a tiny room with this Chest in it. The Mythril Gloves inside give +3 Defense.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: Found in the Fire-Powered Ship’s metal engine room. From the entrance, head down the stairs to the West, then up the stairs a bit further West. You’ll end up on a walkway above the main room: follow it East and then North through the door. The Chest will be in this tiny room, holding an Elixir.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: In the Fire Powered-Ship’s metal engine room. Find it in the North-Western corner of the main room. It’ll contain a Cottage (yes that’s right, an entire Cottage apparently).

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: In the Fire Powered-Ship’s metal engine room. From the entrance, make a wide U-turn to get to the small stairs directly North of the entrance. In the small room will be this Chest with an Elixir.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: Just after using the first elevator in the Fire-Powered Ship, head East to find this Chest at the walkway’s dead-end. It’ll have a Phoenix Down.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: Found after you use the third elevator in the Engine Room, just after going through the vents. Exit this elevator, and you’ll see two more doors to your right (combined with the elevator door, that makes three!), and four chutes on the Southern wall. Take the middle door and ride a fourth elevator up to see the Chest to the West. To reach it, head East and then South to enter some more vents. They’ll lead you to the Chest, which holds a Green Beret. Head back by using the conveyor belt nearby. The Green Beret is a combat hat that increases the wearer’s Strength and Agility by +1. It can be worn by Freelancers, Months, Thieves, Ninjas, Rangers, Blue / Red Mages, Beastmasters, Chemists, Dancers and Mimes.

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: Found after you use the third elevator in the Engine Room, just after going through the vents. Exit this elevator, and you’ll see two more doors to your right (combined with the elevator door, that makes three!), and four chutes on the Southern wall. Here, take the middle-right chute to ride a conveyor belt network and land right in front of a Chest that holds some Thief’s Gloves. These double the Steal success rate to 80% and give +1 Agility, but can only be worn by Freelancers, Thieves and Mimes.

entries.label: Chest 8
entries.guide: Found after you use the third elevator in the Engine Room, just after going through the vents. Exit this elevator, and you’ll see two more doors to your right (combined with the elevator door, that makes three!), and four chutes on the Southern wall. Take the middle-left chute to land in front of a door. Ignore it and head North-East and up the ladder. In this corridor, throw the switch to open up the door to the North, leading to a room with this Chest. The Chest contains the Moonring Blade, a Boomerang equippable by Freelancers, Thieves, Ninjas and Mimes. It has +35 Attack and a hit rate of 95%.

entries.label: Chest 9
entries.guide: Found after the Save Point in the Fire-Powered Ship’s Engine Room, which will be a large room with walkways and switches. To start, head North and flip the switch to move the platform North. Next, throw the switch to the North-West to move a tiny platform East (this will allow you to reach the Chest!). Now flip the switch to the South-West, extending a walkway East. Cross over it and throw both switches on the other side, retracting the walkway you just crossed and extending another to the South. Head there and stand on the square-shaped platform, then hit the switch on its Western edge to be moved Northwards. If you hit the Switch in the North-West corner of this room on your way here, you’ll now be able to go North-West a bit and open the Chest, getting an Elixir!

locations.name: Karnak Castle
missables: Ten-minute timer and 15 chests: Aera is taught by Gigas, Death Claw by the Iron Claw. Beat the Cur Nakks before the Sergeant transforms.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: First, head North out of the Save Point room to arrive back in the dungeon. Head North, but make sure to divert right into the jail cell for the Chest, with 2,000 gil.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: From Chest 1, head to the North-East part of the dungeon and enter the North-Eastern cell here by going South through the door. The Chest will be on the Western wall of the cell: you’ll have to fight a Gigas, but when it’s taken down, you’ll get an Elixir.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: Found just after exiting B4, the dungeon area. In this large library room, check the Chests in the North-Western corner to find a Chest you can open: defeat the Gigas, and you’ll get a Ribbon. The Ribbon can be worn by Freelancers and Dancers, and prevents Instant Death, Petrify, Toad, Poison, Darkness, Old, Berserk and Silence. It also increases Agility, Strength, Magic and Stamina by +5.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: In the same room as Chest 3, only this time in the North-Eastern corner of the library. Defeat the Gigas to get the Shuriken!

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: Exit the Library through the North door and keep going through the rooms until you reach 1F and the main hall. Ignore everything else for the moment and continue through the North-Western door and then up the stairs. In this Chest room, open the left-hand Chest to get 2,000 gil.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: In the same room as Chest 6, in the North-East corner near that Chest. Defeat the Gigas to receive an Elixir.

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: From the spot where Chests 5 and 6 are, take the stairs in the North-West corner to arrive on the roof of Karnack Castle. Head anti-clockwise around the room and head down the series of stairs and through the rooms. You’ll eventually find a Chest: kill the Gigas to receive an Elven Mantle! The Elven Mantle gives a 33% chance of dodging physical attacks, and gives +1 Agility and Magic. As a generic item, it can be used by any class.

entries.label: Chest 8
entries.guide: Return to where Chests 5 and 6 were and take the corridor leading South to find more Chests. Open the one on the Southern wall to fight a Gigas. Kill it to get an Elixir.

entries.label: Chest 9
entries.guide: From Chest 8, head through the doorway on the Southern wall to end up on a balcony outside. Take the right-hand door to get back indoors to more Chests. Open the one in the South-East corner, fight the Gigas, and get another Elixir.

entries.label: Chest 10
entries.guide: In the same place as Chest 9, sitting in the alcove directly North of the entryway. It will also have a Gigas that leaves behind an Elixir once you defeat it.

entries.label: Chest 11
entries.guide: From Chests 9 and 10, take the corridor North to… more Chests! This one will be just North of the end of the corridor. Defeat the Gigas inside to get another Elixir.

entries.label: Chest 12
entries.guide: In the same room as Chest 12, at the base of the column in the North-East corner of the room next to the stairs. It’ll have 2,000 gil.

entries.label: Chest 13
entries.guide: From the room where Chests 11 and 12 are, take the stairs in the North-East corner of the room to get up on the roof. Like with Chest 7, head clockwise around the room and head down the series of stairs and through the rooms. You’ll eventually find a Chest: kill the Gigas, Cur Nakk and Sorcerer to get a Main Gauche. The Main Gauche has a 25% chance of blocking attacks, and can be wielded by all jobs, except Monks and White Mages.

entries.label: Chest 14
entries.guide: With all that done, return to the main entry hall of the castle and head through the first double doors going South. Before taking the next door out of the castle, head West to find this Chest. Defeat the Gigas inside, and you’ll get an Esuna, a White Magic spell that cures Darkness, Poison, Mini, Toad, Petrify, Silence, Confuse, Paralyse, Sleep and Old.

entries.label: Chest 15
entries.guide: In a similar spot as Chest 14, only this time on the Eastern side. Defeat the Sorcerer and two Cur Nakks, and you’ll get a Lightning Scroll! Usable only by Ninjas, when Thrown this will hit all enemies with Thunder elemental damage.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is found on Karnack’s upper wall, however you cannot access it until you’ve travelled through the Fire-Powered Ship. Once you’ve done that, return to the village and go to the North-East corner of the town, where you can climb the stairs up onto the wall. From there, head West and then South to the South-Western corner of the wall. Here, examine the barrel to get a Flame Rod! The Flame Rod has +16 Attack, and will sometimes cast Firaga when used. It will have full power if the wielder is placed in the back of the formation.

locations.name: World Map - Karnak
missables: Titan is summoned from the Karnak meteorite: do it before the world changes.

locations.name: Library of the Ancients
missables: Ifrit is in the basement; Byblos teaches Magic Hammer.
Mana's Paean sits on the top floor and must be taken before the pyramid boss falls: the library is sealed afterwards.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: Found in the first dark room, just after going through the hole in the floor in the shifting bookshelf maze. Here, head South to the intersection and then East to find the Chest.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: Found just after you get past the bookshelf that moves to block you. Once you’ve gotten past it, head down the ladder on the Western side of the room (you can just walk through the hole in the bookcase to get there). You’ll return to the tall library room on a balcony, with the Chest there for the taking! The Ninja Suit inside has +9 Defense, +2 Evasion and +3 Weight.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: Located in the second dark room, just after getting past the bookshelf that moves to block you. You’ll find the Chest in the South-Western-most point of the room.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: In the second section of Jachol Cave. To get here, from the entrance to B1, use the second Skull Switch to the South to open a way South. Head to the Southern-most part of the area to find a line of many Skull Switches. Wait a moment and all but one will disappear: flip it quickly to open the way back North. Lastly, head as far North as you can (past the double doors) and Examine the open Chest to open the double doors. Now that you’re there, head North to the intersection at the water: head West and then South. You’ll look around to find this Chest at a dead-end.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: In the second section of Jachol Cave. To get here, from the entrance to B1, use the second Skull Switch to the South to open a way South. Head to the Southern-most part of the area to find a line of many Skull Switches. Wait a moment and all but one will disappear: flip it quickly to open the way back North. Lastly, head as far North as you can (past the double doors) and Examine the open Chest to open the double doors. Once you’ve made it, head North to the intersection at the water, then head West along the water to find this Chest.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: In the second section of Jachol Cave. To get here, from the entrance to B1, use the second Skull Switch to the South to open a way South. Head to the Southern-most part of the area to find a line of many Skull Switches. Wait a moment and all but one will disappear: flip it quickly to open the way back North. Lastly, head as far North as you can (past the double doors) and Examine the open Chest to open the double doors. When you arrive, head North to the first intersection: take a right to continue Northwards, then at the second intersection, go South to find this Chest at the end! The Blitz Whip has 90 Attack, deals full damage when the wielder is at the back of the formation and has a 33% chance of casting Thunder when used. It can be used by Freelancers and Beastmasters.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest can be found in the Living Quarters of the Catapult, which you get to after using an ancient teleporter and escaping as it collapses. After doing this, head up the stairs, then at the top, make a U-Turn to the South to enter a new room with four beds you can rest in. Here, from the Northern entrance take the Western door into a library. You'll need to follow a chain of clues to find what you need. The chest with the loot will be the left-hand one, closest to the entry.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: In the same spot as Chest 1, only this time it's the middle Chest.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: In the same spot as Chest 1 and 2: open the right-hand Chest here. The Chest contains the Mini ability, a Level 2 Mage spell that shrinks the target, which greatly reduces their physical damage output. If the target is already miniaturized, using this spell on them will reverse its effect, handy if a party member is hit by it.

locations.name: Ronka Ruins
missables: One-time area: twelve chests, and White Wind, 1000 Needles and Level 4 Graviga are taught by its monsters.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: Found in the first room where you learn how to walk across invisible walkways. This will be on the Southern end of the room, just North of the exit. The Golden Armor is a set that offers +11 Defense, ranking it above the Mythril Armor you were able to buy from shops before this point. As a set of Heavy Armor, it can only be worn by Freelancers, Knights, Dragoons, Samurai, Berserkers, Mystic Knights and Mimes.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: This Chest is on Level 3, the room with the wooden machinery gears spinning in the middle. When you arrive, take the invisible path South-West, then head North-West to some more invisible paths. To get to the Chest, take the middle-right path and use it to head North and around to the back of the Chest. You can open it from behind to get the Elixir.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: This Chest is on Level 3, just after you go across the invisible route on the Western side of the room and get to the North-Western corner. From there, head East and you’ll find the Chest just past the staircase with a Phoenix Down inside.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: This Chest is on Level 3, in the North-East corner. To get here, continue South from Chest 3 to get to the Southern part of the room. Head through the doorway to briefly divert through Level 4 and return to Level 3. Head North and across the invisible path, then go North-West to find the Chest with the Golden Shield! The Golden Shield offers +4 Defense and +30 Evasion, making it better than the Mythril Shield. As a Heavy Shield, it can only be used by Freelancers, Knights, Dragoons, Samurai, Berserkers, Mystic Knights, Blue Mages and Mimes.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: This Chest is on Level 4, but is a bit of a walk to get to. On Level 3, head down the stairs in the North-West corner of the room and follow this route until you emerge in the Northern part of Level 5. From here, head East, then South through the white doors and then use the stairs. You’ll emerge on Level 4: the Chest with the Hi-Potion will be directly North.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: This Chest is on Level 4, but is a bit of a walk to get to. On Level 3, head down the stairs in the North-West corner of the room and follow this route until you emerge in the Northern part of Level 5. From here, head East, then South through the white doors and then use the stairs. In this room, use the stairs in the North-Eastern corner, down the hall, then up the stairs to get to a small room with five Chests in it. The room has two booby trapdoors that will send you back a few floors: these are the middle tile and the tile just to the right of that, next to the Eastern-most Chest. In our screenshot above we’ve shown where these trap tiles are. This Chest is the Eastern-most one. It contains a Power Armlet, which gives +4 Defense, +5 Magic Defense and +3 Weight. It can be equipped by Freelancers, Monks, Thieves, Ninjas, Rangers, White / Black / Time / Blue / Red Mages, Summoners, Beastmasters, Chemists, Geomancers, Bards, Dancers and Mimes.

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: This Chest, containing 5,000 gil, is in the chest room where Chest 6 is, specifically the Western-most Chest. Remember to avoid the trap doors in the middle and middle-right tiles of the rooms! They’re displayed in our screenshot above.

entries.label: Chest 8
entries.guide: This Chest, containing a Shuriken, is in the chest room where Chests 6 and 7 are, specifically the North-Western Chest. Remember to avoid the trap doors in the middle and middle-right tiles of the rooms! They’re displayed in our screenshot above.

entries.label: Chest 9
entries.guide: This Chest, containing an Ancient Sword, is in the chest room where Chests 6-8 are, specifically the Northern-most Chest. Remember to avoid the trap doors in the middle and middle-right tiles of the rooms! They’re displayed in our screenshot above. The Ancient Sword has +43 Attack, more powerful than the Mythril and Coral Swords. It also has a 33% chance of inflicting Old on the target.

entries.label: Chest 10
entries.guide: This Chest, containing a Moonring Blade, is in the chest room where Chests 6-8 are, specifically the North-Eastern Chest. Remember to avoid the trap doors in the middle and middle-right tiles of the rooms! They’re displayed in our screenshot above.

entries.label: Chest 11
entries.guide: QUITE a walk to get to! From Chest 5’s location, take the white doors to head South and continue through the ruins. Eventually you’ll emerge on Level 5 with stairs to the South-East (leading to a second Save Point) and some white doors to the West. Head through the white doors and up the stairs. You’ll emerge on Level 4: head through the white doors and head South to find some more stairs on the right and white doors on the left. Go down the stairs to return to Level 5. Head South and use the invisible floor to reach two Chests. This will be the left-hand Chest, and contains a Cottage (yes, an entire Cottage).

entries.label: Chest 12
entries.guide: In the same spot as Chest 11, this will be the Chest on the right-hand side of the room. It’ll have an Ether inside.

locations.name: World Map - Jachol, Istory & Crescent Islands
missables: Istory Village: the Toad spell, Romeo's Ballad and Ramuh.
Lix Village: the Alluring Air song.

locations.name: Castle Exdeath (First Visit)
missables: Pao and the Abductor only appear here.
The Spear is stolen from a Shell Bear.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is found on the second floor of Castle Exdeath, the one with the large open space in the middle. Check the Southern corridor of this floor to find the Chest in the South-West.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: This Chest is found on the second floor of Castle Exdeath, the one with the large open space in the middle. Check the Southern corridor of this floor to find the Chest in the South-East. The Diamond Shield inside is an item you could already get in Shops before this point, but it's always nice to get a freebie, right?

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: Chest 3 is located on the fourth floor of the castle, shortly after Krile exposes the true nature of the castle. Here, head East, South through the archway, East, and then North. At the dead-end you'll see the Chest to your right: to open the way, look for a switch just West that you can flip. The Ice Shield is slightly better than the Diamond Shield, and allows the wielder to absorb Ice damage into HP!

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: This Chest can be found on the fifth floor, the vertically-shaped floor with hidden passages. The Chest will be located next to the exit door in the North-East corner of the area.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: This Chest is located in the lava-filled sixth floor of the castle. Assuming you have the Float spell, stand in the entrance, pause the game, select "Magic", choose the character able to use Level 2 Time Magic, choose Float, and apply it to anyone in the Party. This allows you to safely enter the lava. Walk in by heading South while hugging the wall dividing the lava and the stairs. At the Southern-most point, head East through a hidden passage to find the Chest at the end! Your reward is the Hayate Bow. It has 69 Attack and 80 Accuracy, and has a 25% chance of using Rapid Fire when attacking, which quadruples the number of times the wielder will attack during that turn (at the expense of decreased damage and attacking a randomly-chosen opponent). Since it's a Bow, it can only be used by Freelancers and Rangers.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: This Chest is located on the sixth floor of the castle, with the lava. To get there, head for the stairs in the Southern part of the floor, then follow the right-hand path North. The Chest will be here at the end.

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: The seventh Chest is found on the seventh floor, where you move a platform by standing on a skull plate in the middle of the room. This allows you to access the two Chests flanking the staircase: stop the platform on the left-hand Chest, which is this one (be careful: landing on a pillar will cause an Imp-like enemy to pop out!). The Chest contains Icebrand, a sword with 65 Attack and infused with Ice damage. As a Sword, it can only be used by Freelancers and Knights.

entries.label: Chest 8
entries.guide: The eighth Chest is found on the seventh floor, where you move a platform by standing on a skull plate in the middle of the room. This allows you to access the two Chests flanking the staircase: stop the platform on the right-hand Chest, which is this one (be careful: landing on a pillar will cause an Imp-like enemy to pop out!). The Kotetsu is a Katana with 87 Attack, and a 12% chance of landing a Critical Hit. As a Katana, only Freelancers and Samurai can wield it.

entries.label: Chest 9
entries.guide: The ninth Chest is found on the eighth floor of the castle. From the entry point, make a U-Turn through the archway, East and then South to the dead end. There's actually two hidden passageways here: the Southern-most one stops one tile short of the Chest. Instead, head two tiles North, then head East and then South through the second passageway to access the Chest.

entries.label: Chest 10
entries.guide: Chest 10 is located close to the North-Western exit to the eighth floor. At the start of the path leading up to it, head West and North up the side-path to find this Chest at the dead-end.

entries.label: Chest 11
entries.guide: This Chest is found on the 10th floor, however you access it from the 9th floor, the one where all the floor literally is lava. You'll need to use Float (a Level 2 Time Mage ability) to cross it: do this by going to the Magic option in the pause menu, then selecting Time Magic, then Float. Once you've done this, head up the stairs in the North-Eastern corner of the floor. You'll emerge on the 10th floor, with the Chest right in front of you!

entries.label: Chest 12
entries.guide: Chest 12 is also on the 10th floor, however it's at the far end of a platform with several hidden trap doors in the floor. To avoid these, you can either use the map provided above, or use the Level 3 Geomancer ability Find Pits, which automatically reveals them just like in the screenshot. The Chest contains Twin Lance, a boomerang with 61 Damage, but hits the target twice. As a Boomerang, it can be used by Freelancers, Thieves, Ninja and Mimes.

entries.label: Chest 13
entries.guide: This Chest is found on the eleventh floor, located plainly in the exact middle of the room. Despite containing nothing at first, opening it will trigger an optional fight against Gilgamesh, who will drop Excalipoor upon his defeat.

entries.label: Chest 14
entries.guide: This Chest can be from the 11th floor of the castle, the one with the wide open room with a Chest in the middle. Here, take the North-Eastern staircase to find a small room with two Chests. This will be the right-hand Chest. Partisan is a Spear with 62 Attack, and is thus the strongest Spear available thus far in the game. Spears can only be used by Freelancers and Dragoons.

entries.label: Chest 15
entries.guide: This Chest can be from the 11th floor of the castle, the one with the wide open room with a Chest in the middle. Here, take the North-Eastern staircase to find a small room with two Chests. This will be the right-hand Chest. The item inside is a Fuma Shuriken, which can be thrown with the Ninja's Throw ability for 117 physical damage (which will then be increased by the thrower's Strength and Agility stats). As a th

locations.name: Big Bridge
missables: Gilgamesh's first fight: four bestiary entries appear on the bridge and nowhere else.

locations.name: Sealed Castle (Kuza)
locations.note: The Sealed Room's twelve chests open as you collect tablets.
missables: Each tablet unlocks more of the Sealed Room: Holy and Flare, Meteor, Leviathan and Bahamut all come from the tablet quests.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: Found early in the Underground Waterway. After riding through the river for the second time, head East, then South through a small passage. On the other side you'll spot the Chest to the East.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: Found in the South-Eastern part of the Underground Waterway. You'll wind up pretty close to it however you choose to get here: just head North after riding through the water / emerging from the side room.

locations.name: Castle of Bal
missables: In the merged world, Odin waits in the basement reached from Jachol Cave.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: Found in the Throne Room, which is the room where you regain control after arriving here from the Moogle Village. It will be the only unopened Chest on the Western side of the room. The item inside is the Hero Cocktail, which can only be used by a Chemist via the Drink command. Its effect will raise the drinker's Strength for the remainder of the battle.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: This Chest is also found in the Castle of Bal's Throne Room. On the left-hand side of the room are three Chests; head South into the alcove to reveal a secret passage, leading to this Chest! The Chest contains the Teleport time magic spell. Usable only by Time Mages, if used in a battle it will allow the party to instantly escape. If used in a dungeon, it will take the party back to the entrance.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: This Chest is found in the Eastern building in the Castle of Bal that has the Spell, Weapons and Armor shops. Head inside, then go North and take the stairs up onto the roof. Here, go directly East to head down a staircase obscured by the tall roof of a tower. Head down and open the Chest in the North-West corner of the room. The Angel Robe has +10 Defense, and gives the wearer to resist the Poison status effect. However it can only be worn by Chemists, Mimes and Freelancers.

entries.label: Item 1
entries.guide: This Item is found in the Castle of Bal's moat. To get here, look for the small pool in the South-West corner of the castle grounds and go to its South-Western corner. You'll be sucked out onto the moat. From here, head counter-clockwise to the North-East corner of the moat. There, check the South-West corner to find the Great Sword! The Great Sword has 57 Attack, making it the most powerful sword in the game thus far. As a Sword, it can be used by Freelancers, Knights, Mystic Knights and Blue / Red Mages.

locations.name: Quelb
missables: Requiem is learned from the wolves around Quelb.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: In the North-Eastern house of the Moogle Village. To get in here, talk to the Moogle behind the tree house to be let inside. This will be the bottom-left Chest.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: In the same location as Chest 2. It will be in the middle-left Chest.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: In the same location as Chests 1 and 2, in the top-left Chest.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: In the same location as Chests 1-3, in the top-right Chest.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: In the same location as Chests 1-4, in the middle-right Chest. The Dancing Dagger has 51 Attack, making it the strongest Knife available by this point in the game. As a Knife, it can be used by all Jobs, except Monks and White Mages.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: In the same location as Chests 1-5, in the bottom-right Chest.

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: To access this Chest, you'll either have to be let into the North-East tree house by the Moogle nearby, or exit and re-enter the village. After doing either of those two things, head into the tree house directly North of the Moogle Village entrance and interact with the Moogle suit to put it on. Exit the tree house and enter the one next-door to the West: talk to the Moogle inside, and it'll unlock the Chest for you to loot!

locations.name: Drakenvale
missables: Golem is found in Drakenvale: summon it before the world changes.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: Found from the start of the Drakenvale Mountain pass. As you begin the climb, keep an eye out on your right for a cave entrance in a diagonal wall. Head inside to find the Chest in the small room.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: Found inside the cave you enter while climbing up the starting cliffs (it exits out to a wooden bridge). You'll find it in the South-East corner, close to the Southern exit of the cave.

entries.label: Item 1
entries.guide: Found in the section of the Mountain Path with bones scattered about. Here, look for a skull North-East of the Southern cave entrance. Check the bones just South of this skull to get Bone Mail! The Bone Mail will cause the wearer to become undead, allowing them to absorb Poison attack damage into health, and grants immunity from Death, Darkness, Regen, Old, Confuse and Berserk. The cost of this however is the wearer having halved Ice damage, being weak to Fire and Holy attacks, and the inability to be revived in battle.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: Found in the small cave just after the field of bones, with a skull switch on the lower level. Here, look for the trap door on the right side of the upper level and fall down it. You'll land right next to this chest!

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: Found in the cave accessed by hitting a skull switch in the "bone field" cave. When you enter, take the left-hand path to find a room behind the entrance with two chests. This will be the left-hand one. The Hypno Crown inside, when equipped, increases the chances of the Control ability being successful.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: Found in the cave accessed by hitting a skull switch in the "bone field" cave. When you enter, take the left-hand path to find a room behind the entrance with two chests. This will be the left-hand one. The Wind Slash inside is a Katana, so can only be used by Freelancers and Samurai. With 44 attack it's only slightly better than the Ashura blade available from some shops, but it also has a 12% chance of casting the Wind Slash ability, and increases the power of Wind-based attacks by 50%.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: Found in the cave accessed by hitting a skull switch in the "bone field" cave. When you enter, take the right-hand path. When you emerge out of a rocky doorway, look to your right to find this chest, which contains a Phoenix Down.

locations.name: Surgate Castle
missables: The Swift Song is found here.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is a bit lengthy to get to, and requires solving a light puzzle! To get to it, start in the Throne Room and take the North-Western stairs to get to the roof. Head East, then North back inside. Take the stairs to the East to enter a library: continue East and down more stairs to get to the puzzle room. Your task here is to help the elderly librarian clean up after the scholars and return three books to their correct sections. All three books are on the tables on the Southern wall; if you place them incorrectly, exit and re-enter the room to try again. Once you're done, talk to the Librarian and she'll leave via a hidden exit to the North. Use it and go up the stairs, then go South and down the stairs. In this room with the robed man, open the Chest in the South-East corner to get 5,000 gil!

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: This Chest can be found from the room where Chest 1 is. That requires some navigation and solving a library book puzzle, so read the section above if you haven't already. From the room with the old man where Chest 1 is, head South out the door and onto the castle grounds. Head West and "through" the walkway to get to the other side, then go North through the door. Continue up the stairs to find a tiny storage room. The Chest will be in the South-West corner. The spell inside the Chest,Float, will cast the Float status effect to the target, allowing them to avoid Earth-based damage, as well as floor traps. As it's a Time Magic spell, it can only be used by Time Mages.

locations.name: Xezat's Fleet
missables: Let Gilgamesh summon Enkidu before you finish him.
Genji Gloves are stolen from Gilgamesh.

locations.name: Barrier Tower
missables: One-time area: Level 2 Old from a Level Tricker, Level 3 Flare from the Red Dragon, Time Slip from a Traveler, and the Gold Hairpin.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is found in the second room of the Barrier Tower, in the North-Western part of the room. It'll be just North of the exit.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: This Chest is found in the second room of the Barrier Tower, in the North-Western part of the room. At the intersection, head North and around the bend to get to it. Rather than an item, it contains the Red Dragon enemy that you fight the moment you open the chest. Defeat it, and you'll get a Blood Sword. This is a Knight Sword, meaning it can only be used by Knights and Freelancers. With 84 Attack, it's the most powerful sword thus far in the game, and it heals the wielder by the same amount it damages the target!

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: Found on the sixth floor of the Barrier Tower. After the room with Chests 1 and 2, you'll head outside, climb up some stairs, return inside, head back outside again, up more stairs and then back inside. At that point, look left to spot the Chest!

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: Located on the Xth floor of the Barrier Tower. At a certain point, Xezat will contact the party via Whisperweed. From here, continue through the room and back outside. Here, take the Western staircase up and through the door. The Chest will be in this tiny room. When you open it, you'll have to fight either a Red Dragon or two Yellow Dragons. Once they're down, you'll get a Gold Hairpin. It's classed as a Magic Hat, so it can only be used by White / Black / Time / Blue / Red Mages, Summoners, Chemists, Geomancers, Bards, Dancers and Mimes. While it doesn't have very good stats, it will half the MP cost of all spells!

entries.label: Item 1
entries.guide: This item is found in one of the wooden barrels in the South-Western part of town. You'll have to walk counter-clockwise around the pub in order to access it.

locations.name: Forest of Moore
missables: Twelve chests split nine before the tree changes, one during it and two after.
Lilliputian Lyric is taught by a Mini Magician.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is found in the opening area of the Forest of Moore. Simply head North from the entryway to find it at the base of a tree.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: Also located in the Forest of Moore's opening area. You can find it in the North-Eastern part of this area, to the right of a tree with a hole in its trunk. However it'll be obscured by the forest canopy, so you won't be able to see it until you get close.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: Found in the second area of the forest. From the entrance, follow the left-hand wall of bushes North, which will lead you to the Chest next to some flowers.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: From Chest 3, continue following the wall of bushes to the North-East, where you'll enter a small clearing (this is the most Northerly part of this forest section). Here are two trees, with the Chest located between them.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: This Chest is found in the Eastern part of the second area of the forest. Here you'll find another tree with a hole in its trunk: before examining it, make a southwards U-turn to arrive at a tree directly East of the "hole tree". Just North-East of it will be this Chest!

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: This Chest is located in the third area of the forest (which is technically the Eastern side of the first area, but anyway...). You can find it at the base of a tree just North-West of the entrance to this area, and among some flowers.

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: Found in the third area of the forest. It'll be just East of the entrance, close to a tree and some flowers. The Chest contains the Goliath Tonic, which doubles the drinker's maximum HP for the duration of a battle. It can only be consumed using the Chemist's Drink ability.

entries.label: Chest 8
entries.guide: This Chest is found in the middle portion of the third area of the forest. It'll be directly North-West of the Save Point in the flowers, on the western wall of bushes.

entries.label: Chest 9
entries.guide: This Chest is in the Northerm-most part of the forest's third area. You'll find it in the North-Western corner, between two trees and next to some flowers. The item inside is a Morning Star, a Stave that can be equipped by Freelancers, White / Time / Red MAges, Chemists and Mimes. While it has a Damage stat of 50, it will only deal the full amount of it if the wielder is in the back row.

entries.label: Chest 10
entries.guide: This Chest is found just after the story event and you take refuge in the Moogle Cave. Talk to the Moogle guarding the exit so they'll move out of the way, then check the tree North-West of the cave's entrance hole. The Chest will be here to the right of the tree. The item inside is a Flame Shield, granting +40 Defense. It also allows the wielder to absorb Fire attacks into HP.

entries.label: Chest 11
entries.guide: This Chest is found in the forest after the story event and you take refuge in the Moogle Cave. After leaving the cave, continue West. You should be able to spot this Chest passing by the top of the screen next to a dead tree. It'll be North-East of the exit to this area. The item inside is Ash, which can be used with the Ninja's Throw command. With an Attack value of 25, it is the weakest of the throwable items.

entries.label: Chest 12
entries.guide: The final Chest in the Great Forest of Moore, this can be found just West of Chest 11 and North-West of the exit, on the Western wall of bushes and next to a pile of rocks. The item inside is the Flametounge sword, which deals Fire damage and has 63 Attack. As a Knight Sword, it can only be used by Freelancers and Knights.

locations.name: Castle Exdeath (Second Visit)
missables: Point of no return: the castle is gone once you leave it.
Power Staff (Black Warlock drop), Genji Helm (steal), Excalipoor and Carbuncle are all inside.
Bestiary 030, 071, 082, 121, 123-134, 158, 255 and 271-273 must already be recorded.

locations.name: Pyramid of Moore
missables: Mana's Paean is on the Library of the Ancients' top floor: collect it before the pyramid boss dies or it is lost.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: Found early in the Pyramid of Moore. After crossing some spikes, you'll be forced to go down a sand slide. When you land in the basement, the Chest will be in the South-West corner. Be careful, as opening it will force you to fight four The Damned!

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: Found at the end of the side path on the first floor, where you go down a sand slide, then find a sarcophagus. Open it to fight a Grand Mummy and open the way into a secret room. The Chest will be there. The item inside is a Cursed Ring, which gives +25 Defense, at the expense of inflicting the Doom status on the wearer at the start of every battle, which kills them when the timer runs out.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: Found on the third floor in the Pyramid of Moore. When you arrive, head directly North to find a room with three chests. This will be the left-hand one, but you will have to fight four The Damned in order to get the item.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: Found on the third floor in the Pyramid of Moore. When you arrive, head directly North to find a room with three chests. This will be the middle one, but you will have to fight four The Damned in order to get the item. The chest contains Dark Matter, which is used as a mixing ingredient for Chesmists. Mix it with a Phoenix Down to make a Death Potion, which kills all enemies except those immune to the Death status effect.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: Found on the third floor in the Pyramid of Moore. When you arrive, head directly North to find a room with three chests. This will be the right-hand one, but you will have to fight an Archeosaur and two Ushabti in order to get the item. The item inside, the White Robe, gives +3 Stamina and Magic. It can be worn by all Mages, Summoners, Chemists, Geomancers, Bards, Dancers and Freelancers.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: On the sandy fourth floor of the Pyramid of Moore, up the stairs in the northeastern corner of the sandy area.

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: On the sandy fourth floor of the Pyramid of Moore. Head for the sarcophagus at the top of the main sandy area, then open it and defeat the three Mummys. That done, head north down the secret corridor to find the Chest at the end. The item inside is a Thornlet, a helmet that has +20 Defense, +5 Magic Defense and prevents Sleep. However it also inflicts +4 Weight, -5 Magic and inflicts the Sap status that periodically takes away a tiny amount of health.

entries.label: Chest 8
entries.guide: On the sandy fourth floor of the Pyramid of Moore. Head for the top of the sandy area, then go up the northwestern stairs to find the chest.

entries.label: Chest 9
entries.guide: On the sandy fourth floor of the Pyramid of Moore. Head to the southwestern corner of the floor to find a button. Press it to lower the spikes in the hallway to the left (and spawn two Apsis on the map). Head to the end of this hallway to get to the chest, although opening it will force a fight with an Archeosaur first. The chest contains a Black Robe, which gives +14 Defense and Magic Defense, +20 Magic Evation and +5 Magic. It can be worn by all Mages, Summoners, Chemists, Geomancers, Bards, Dancers and Freelancers.

entries.label: Chest 10
entries.guide: On the fifth floor of the Pyramid of Moore. From the entry stairs, head through the open sarcophagus and then go south. At the corner, continue south to enter a hidden passage (you can use the Thief job or the Find Passages ability to see them). To navigate the passages, head east three steps, north as far as you can go, east as far as you can go, north one step, then east into the room. The chest will be here, but opening it will force a fight against a randomly-chosen set of monsters. The chest contains a Black Garb, which gives a healthy +17 Defense, as well as +2 Magic Defense, +1 Strength, +3 Weight and +1 Agility. It can be worn by Knights, Months, Thieves, Dragoons, Ninjas, Samurai, Berserkers, Rangers, Mystic Knights, Blue and Red Mages, Beastmasters, Chemists, Dancers and Mimes.

entries.label: Chest 11
entries.guide: In a small sub-floor of 5F in the Pyramid of Moore, which you can get to by going up the northwestern stairs of the fifth floor. It'll be the left-hand chest, and will force a fight with four The Damned when you open it.

entries.label: Chest 12
entries.guide: In a small sub-floor of 5F in the Pyramid of Moore, which you can get to by going up the northwestern stairs of the fifth floor. It'll be the right-hand chest, and will force a fight with five Objet d'Arts when you open it. The chest will contain some Crystal Armor, which provides a whopping +20 Defense and +2 Magic Defense, at the cost of +8 Weight.

entries.label: Chest 13
entries.guide: On the fifth floor of the Pyramid of Moore, however it requires you to go to the sixth floor. When you get there, ignore the button on the wall and intentionally go down the first sand stream. You'll land in a room on the fifth floor with this chest in it. Open it and defeat the four The Damned to get some Dark Matter. Once you're done, leave via the secret passage on the western wall of the room (you can use the Thief job or the Find Passages ability to see them).

entries.label: Chest 14
entries.guide: In a side-room of the sixth floor in the Pyramid of Moore. After using the button to get past the first sand stream, enter the door in the northeast corner to get into a side room. Here will be a block with two buttons: press the left-hand button to move it upwards, letting you enter the next room. The chest will be the left-hand one on the western side of the room. Fight the four The Damned to get some Dark Matter.

entries.label: Chest 15
entries.guide: In a side-room of the sixth floor in the Pyramid of Moore. After using the button to get past the first sand stream, enter the door in the northeast corner to get into a side room. Here will be a block with two buttons: press the left-hand button to move it upwards, letting you enter the next room. The chest will be the right-hand one on the western side of the room. Fight the four The Damned to get some Dark Matter.

entries.label: Chest 16
entries.guide: In a side-room of the sixth floor in the Pyramid of Moore. After using the button to get past the first sand stream, enter the door in the northeast corner to get into a side room. Here will be a block with two buttons: press the left-hand button to move it upwards, letting you enter the next room. The chest will be the left-hand one on the eastern side of the room, and contains 9,000 gil.

entries.label: Chest 17
entries.guide: In a side-room of the sixth floor in the Pyramid of Moore. After using the button to get past the first sand stream, enter the door in the northeast corner to get into a side room. Here will be a block with two buttons: press the left-hand button to move it upwards, letting you enter the next room. The chest will be the right-hand one on the eastern side of the room, and contains 8,000 gil.

entries.label: Chest 18
entries.guide: This chest is on the seventh floor of the Pyramid of Moore, and is within the secret passages (you can use the Thief job or the Find Passages ability to see them). To get to the passages, head through the doors to the left of the exit stairs into the top-most room, then go left. The chest will be further left, but before you can get the item, you'll have to fight either four The Damned (SNES / PlayStation / GBA / Pixel Remaster) or three Steel Fists (Mobile / Steam). The item inside is a Gaia Hammer, which can be used by Berserkers and Freelancers. With 58 Attack, it's the second-strongest hammer the game.

entries.label: Chest 19
entries.guide: This chest is on the seventh floor of the Pyramid of Moore, and is accessed via the secret passages (you can use the Thief job or the Find Passages ability to see them). To get to the passages, head through the doors to the left of the exit stairs into the top-most room, then go left. From here, head north, then east until you're above another door you can head south through. The chest will be here.

entries.label: Chest 20
entries.guide: This chest is on the seventh floor of the Pyramid of Moore, and is within the secret passages (you can use the Thief job or the Find Passages ability to see them). To get to the passages, head through the doors to the left of the exit stairs into the top-most room, then go left. From here, head west one step, then all the way north, then all the way east to bump into the chest.

entries.label: Chest 21
entries.guide: This chest is on the seventh floor of the Pyramid of Moore, and is within the secret passages (you can use the Thief job or the Find Passages ability to see them). To get to the passages, head through the doors to the left of the exit stairs into the top-most room, then go left. From here, head west one step, then all the way north, then all the way east to bump into Chest 19. There, go back west one step, then all the way south, then east, then south again to find Chest 20.

entries.label: Chest 22
entries.guide: This chest is on the eighth floor of the Pyramid of Moore, the one with the shifting floor tiles. This will be the middle chest of the three: wait for the floor arrangement to switch to the one that lets you walk straight up to it so you can open it. Be aware however that the floor will disappear from under you if you aren't quick. So before setting out, identify a tile that stays on at all times, then return to it after opening the chest. If you do fall, you'll go back to the seventh floor and have to backtrack through a secret passage (you can use the Thief job or the Find Passages ability to see it). The item inside is a Protect Ring. This grants the Auto-Regen status that restores HP over time. It also gives +10 Defense, Magic Evasion and Magic Defense, in addition to +1 Weight and +5 Stamina.

entries.label: Chest 23
entries.guide: This chest is on the eighth floor of the Pyramid of Moore, the one with the shifting floor tiles. This will be the left-hand chest of the three, meaning you can't walk over to it directly. Instead, identify the safe floor tile to the right of the chest: stand on this, then wait for the floor to change so you can safely walk to the next safe tile just above the chest.

entries.label: Chest 24
entries.guide: This chest is on the eighth floor of the Pyramid of Moore, the one with the shifting floor tiles. This will be the right-hand chest of the three, meaning you can't walk over to it directly. Instead, identify the safe floor tile to the left of the chest: stand on this, then wait for the floor to change so you can safely walk to the next safe tile just above the chest.

entries.label: Chest 25
entries.guide: This Chest is on the seventh floor of the Pyramid, however to get to it you'll have to cross the shifting floor of the eighth floor. You'll need to navigate to the stairs in the northeastern corner. Once you've done so, you'll appear to the right of some purple stairs. Head down and up through the door to enter a room with two chests: this will be the left one.

entries.label: Chest 26
entries.guide: This Chest is on the seventh floor of the Pyramid, however to get to it you'll have to cross the shifting floor of the eighth floor. You'll need to navigate to the stairs in the northeastern corner. Once you've done so, you'll appear to the right of some purple stairs. Head down and up through the door to enter a room with two chests: this will be the right one. Defeat the four The Damned to get the item.

entries.label: Chest 27
entries.guide: This Chest is on the seventh floor of the Pyramid, however to get to it you'll have to cross the shifting floor of the eighth floor. You'll need to navigate to the stairs in the northwestern corner. Once you've done so, you'll appear to the left of some purple stairs. Head down and up through the door to enter a room with two chests: this will be the left one.

entries.label: Chest 28
entries.guide: This Chest is on the seventh floor of the Pyramid, however to get to it you'll have to cross the shifting floor of the eighth floor. You'll need to navigate to the stairs in the northwestern corner. Once you've done so, you'll appear to the left of some purple stairs. Head down and up through the door to enter a room with two chests: this will be the right one. Defeat the four The Damned to get the item.

locations.name: Island Shrine
missables: The Damned teaches Doom here.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: Found on the second floor of the Island Shrine, after defeating the Gargoyles at the entrance. Here, search the right-hand wall for a secret passage (you can use the Thief job or the Find Passages ability to see it). Head east, north and then west to find the secret room, with this chest in it.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: In the "vent switches" room you appear in after getting sucked into the vents for the first time. Here, head for the southwestern corner of the room and examine the left-hand wall here (your character should NOT be obscured by the southern wall at all). When the "!" bubble appears, interact with it to get the Hi-Potion.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: In the "vent switches" room you appear in after getting sucked into the vents for the first time. Here, head for the southeastern corner of the room and examine the left-hand wall here (your character be almost completely obscured by the southern wall). When the "!" bubble appears, interact with it to get the item. Said item is an Iron Draft, which casts Protect on the user. Since it's used with the Drink command, it can only be used by Chemists or Freelancers, however if you level up the Chemist job to Level 1, the Drink command can be equipped as an Ability.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: This chest is in one of the "vent network" rooms. From the vent room with the switches on the north wall, make sure the left switch is pulled up and the right switch is pulled down. When you enter the vent to the south, you'll be taken to a small, tall room with a tall column on the left and a short column on the right. The chest will be next to the left-hand column.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: This chest is in one of the "vent network" rooms. From the vent room with the switches on the north wall, make sure both switches are pulled down. When you enter the vent to the south, you'll be taken to a small, tall room with a broken column to the south, with this chest between it and the southern wall.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: This chest is in one of the "vent network" rooms. From the vent room with the switches on the north wall, make sure the left switch is pulled down and the right switch is pulled up. When you enter the vent to the south, you'll be taken to a small room, wide room. The chest will be on the western side of the room between two pillars. Be aware that you'll have to fight either a Covert or a Pantera, both of whom are bosses. They also only appear here and are mutually exclusive, and thus are not counted in the Bestiary. The item inside is the Rising Sun, the strongest Boomerang in the game with 71 Attack, but with a 90% hit rate. As a Boomerang, it can only be used by Thieves, Ninjas, Mimes and Freelancers.

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: This chest is found in the large room with columns after the first Save Point. Head north from the entry door to find it on a wall, wedged between two columns. You'll have to fight a Mecha Head first before obtaining the item.

entries.label: Chest 8
entries.guide: This chest is found in the large room with columns after the first Save Point. From the entrance, head north from the entryway to Chest 7, then go west past the columns as far as you can, then north. The chest will be here in the northwestern corner of this floor.

entries.label: Chest 9
