entries.guide: This chest is found in the large room with columns after the first Save Point. From the entrance, head north from the entryway to Chest 7, then go east past the column. Here will be a secret passage you can walk through (you can use the Thief job or the Find Passages ability to see it). From there, go north to the northeastern corner of the floor to find the chest. The item inside is the Crystal Helm, which has +13 Attack, +2 Magic Defense and +4 Weight. As a helmet, it can only be worn by Knights, Dragoons, Samurai, Berserkers, Mystic Knights and Mimes.

entries.label: Chest 10
entries.guide: This chest is found on the third floor of the Island Shrine. From the southern entrance, head north through the doors to enter a side-room with this chest in it. The item inside is a Beast Killer whip. With +82 Attack, it's the third most powerful Whip in the game, and has 100% accuracy. As a whip, it can only be used by Beastmasters and Freelancers.

entries.label: Chest 11
entries.guide: This chest is in the middle of the 5th floor of the Island Shrine. It's filled with columns, but also trap doors that will send you down to the 4th floor if you step on them. You can see the trap doors by using the picture provided above, or by using the Thief Job or giving someone the Find Passages ability. This chest is specifically the one of the left side. To grab it safely, hug the left-hand wall going north, then go east to open the chest from the left-hand side.

entries.label: Chest 12
entries.guide: This chest is in the middle of the 5th floor of the Island Shrine. It's filled with columns, but also trap doors that will send you down to the 4th floor if you step on them. You can see the trap doors by using the picture provided above, or by using the Thief Job or giving someone the Find Passages ability. This chest is specifically the right-hand one. To grab is safely, align yourself between the middle and right-hand rows of columns. Walk north between them, then go east to walk behind the upper-right column. From there you can open the chest from behind. The item inside is a Dragon Fang, a potion ingredient used in some rather powerful brews. It requires the Mix ability to use, meaning it can only be used by Chemists or a Freelancer who has been given the Mix ability.

entries.label: Chest 13
entries.guide: This chest is on the seventh floor of the Island Shrine, the room after the second Save Point where the music changes. From the southern entrance, head up the northwestern path to find this chest at the end.

entries.label: Chest 14
entries.guide: This chest is on the seventh floor of the Island Shrine, the room after the second Save Point where the music changes. From the southern entrance, head up the northeastern path to find this chest at the end. The item inside is a Circlet, a type of magic hat that gives +10 Attack, +3 Magic, +2 Magic Defense, +5 Magic Evasion and +2 Weight. As a magic hat, it can be worn by all Mages, Summoners, Chemists, Geomancers, Bards, Dancers, Necromancers and Mimes.

locations.name: Fork Tower
missables: Four chests, two on each side.
Kornago Gourd and the Blitz Whip are stolen from enemies inside; the magic side holds bestiary 162-164 and the physical side 165-167.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This chest is located on the fourth floor of the Black Tower, the left-hand one. The fourth floor is the one where you have to briefly divert outside onto a balcony in order to access the next set of stairs. Instead of taking these stairs, continue north down the right side of it to find this chest at the end of the path.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: This chest is located on the fourth floor of the Black Tower, the left-hand one. The seventh floor is the one after floor six where you have to divert outside for the second time. Once you're on the seventh floor, you can find the chest on the left-hand side of the room. The item is the Wonder Want, a unique Rod that has zero MP cost, as it casts spells when using the Attack command. Despite its description, it actually casts spells in a specific order, ascending to more powerful spells before looping back. The Wonder Wand remembers its position in the list across fights. As a Rod, it can only be used by Mages, Summoners and Freelancers.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: This chest is located on the fourth floor of the Black Tower, the right-hand one. The fourth floor is the one where you have to briefly divert outside onto a balcony in order to access the next set of stairs. Instead of taking these stairs, continue north down the right side of it to find this chest at the end of the path. This will be in the same place as you found Chest 1 in the Black Tower.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: This chest is located on the fourth floor of the White Tower, the right-hand one. The seventh floor is the one after floor six where you have to divert outside for the second time. Once you're on the seventh floor, you can find the chest on the left-hand side of the room, in the same place you found Chest 2 in the Black Tower. The item inside is Defender, the fourth-strongest Knight Sword in the game with 99 Attack, in addition to having a 25% chance to block attacks, and casting the Protect spell if used as an item. As a Knight Sword, it can only be used by Freelancers and Knights.

locations.name: Phantom Village
missables: The piano is hidden behind a false wall, and the village keeps secret merchants.
Playing all eight pianos finishes the song list: seven gives Sinewy Etude, the eighth adds Hero's Rime.

entries.label: Item 1
entries.guide: The only tracked item is found in Phantom Village's pub in the northern part of the village. Enter it via the secret entrance in the northwestern corner of the building, which gets you behind the bar. There will be a line of barrels alongside the bar: check the second-to-last barrel to get the Thief Knife. If you need to get past the bartender, keep walking into him for a second to walk past. The Thief Knife is the fifth-most powerful Knife in the game with 66 Attack, and +1 Agility. What makes it special is that it has a 50% chance of mugging, stealing an item from the target!

entries.label: Item 0
entries.guide: This item is NOT tracked by the game, however it's the only way to get this item without it being dropped by a Tonberry or stealing it from a Oiseaurare, so we've included it here regardless. To get to it, enter the pub via the secret entrance in the northwestern corner of the building, then exit via the door to the left to get to the pub's back room. In this room you'll find a man who'll only give you the item if you complete a ride around the world on a yellow Chocobo. Boko, Bartz' Chocobo from the beginning of the game, is the only yellow Chocobo, so you'll first have to find him! Boko is most likely found hanging around outside Ghido's Cave, which will be on the northwestern side of the body of water in the middle of the map. You can also use the World Map to locate Boko, as all your mounts and vehicles are at the top of the World Map location list. Now you'll need to figure out how to get across the entire map on Boko. The image above has a route marked, but here's some step-by-step instructions to help out as well. Circumnavigation complete, return to the man in the pub's back room and talk to him again to get the Mirage Vest! The Mirage Vest is the fourth-strongest Light Vest, with 17 Defense, 2 Magic Defense and 3 Weight. Its perk is to start every battle with "Image (1)", meaning the first attack will deal no damage to the one wearing it (this can be reset mid-battle by swapping weapons, except in the Mobile versions).

entries.label: Item 0
entries.guide: This item is untracked, but can only be obtained in World 3. Head for Regole (the town in the northeastern corner of the northern lake) and enter the armor shop. In the Armor Shop, look for the secret passage to the right of the door that gets you behind the counter (you can use the Thief job or the Find Passages ability to see it). Talk to the girl, and she'll give you a Ribbon!

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This chest is found in B2 of the Great Sea Trench, the area after defeating the two Gargoyles at the entrance. From the entry point, head east until you come to a split in the path. Head south here to find the chest at the end. The chest contains a Water Scroll, which deals 120 water damage on all enemies at the cost of 200 MP. It can only be used with the Throw ability, meaning only Ninjas and Freelancers can use it.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: This chest is located in the fourth area of the Great Sea Trench, the one with the five columns with skull switches on them. Press the northeastern skull switch, and a bridge will extend in the north of this area. Head across the bridge to find the chest! The item inside is a Flame Ring, which gives +5 Defense, Magic Defence and Magic Evasion. Its perk is that all Fire attack damage is absorbed into health, at the expense of making the wearer weak to Water attack damage.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: This chest is located in the fifth area of the Great Sea Trench, but it's accessed via the fourth, the one with the five columns with skull switches on them. Here, press the first skull switch you find when heading north from the entryway: a hole will open up and you'll fall to B5. Next, go east and then north to find this chest in the northern-most part of the area.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: This chest is found in the sixth basement level of the Great Sea Trench, the maze-like area you need to navigate by casting Float on your party to safely cross the lava. From the northwestern entrance, follow the western wall south until you come to some steps leading into the lava. Cast Float on the party, then head south, then north up some steps to the chest.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: This chest is found in the sixth basement level of the Great Sea Trench, the maze-like area you need to navigate by casting Float on your party to safely cross the lava. From the northwestern entrance, follow the western wall south until you come to some steps leading into the lava. Cast Float on the party, then head south, east past the steps to Chest 4, then north up to safe ground. From there, head east and then south back into more lava.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: The final chest in the Great Sea Trench is on the eighth floor of the basement, which is another where you have to cast Float on the party to safely navigate through lava. Here, head for the northeastern part of the lava pool and push the skull switch at the top of the stairs. This opens a door to the left: head through it to find this chest at the end of the room. The Kaiser Knuckles inside give +5 Strength and 8 Defense. Their perk is adding 50 Attack if the user is barehanded, which works especially well with the Monk job (kicks however are not boosted in the mobile version of the game).

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This chest is found in the first room of Istory Falls, right after defeating the gargoyles at the entrance. From the rooms southern entrance, head north up the steps, west a bit, south down a waterfall, then west a bit. You can then go north up three flights of stairs to find this chest at the top. The item inside is a Turtle Shell mixing ingredient, meaning it can only be used by Chemists or Freelancers given the Mix ability. It can be used in a wide variety of brews, including a few that can only be made with a Turtle Shell.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: This chest is found in the first room of Istory Falls, right after defeating the gargoyles at the entrance. From the rooms southern entrance, head north up the steps, west a bit, south down a waterfall, then west a bit. From there, head north up a flight of stairs, then west a bit, south down a shorter flight of stairs, then northeast and north up another flight of stairs. Stand at the bottom of the next set of stairs, then walk south to fall down a waterfall and land right next to this chest!

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: This chest is found in the first room of Istory Falls, right after defeating the gargoyles at the entrance. From the rooms southern entrance, head north up the steps, west a bit, south down a waterfall, then west a bit. From here, head north up the first flight of stairs, then go east and north to go up a second flight of stairs. Now head east and go down a tiny flight of steps to get to the chest. Nice! The Air Knife is the sixth most powerful knife in the game, with 56 Attack. Its attacks have the Wind element, and it also boosts the damage of other Wind elemental attacks by 50%. As a Knife it can be used by all jobs except Monks and White Mages.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: This chest is found in the second basement level of Istory Falls. It's specifically found on the eastern ledges of the room, which you can access via some stairs in the southeastern corner.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: This chest is found in the second basement level of Istory Falls. There, head for the southeastern corner of the room, then go through a secret passage that goes east and then north to the chest at the end. The item inside is Rune Blade, the fourth most powerful sword with 50 attack. Its ability is consuming 8 MP to add +20 Attack and Magic to its damage formula (which uses the Axe formula). As a Sword, it can be used by Freelancers, Knights, Mystic Knights, Blue Mages, and Red Mages.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: This chest is found in the second basement level of Istory Falls, specifically up on the northwestern wall. It will be blocked by a strong waterfall controlled by a skull switch. What you need to do is hit the switch, then use Sprint to run fast enough to open the chest before the waterfall comes back on and washes you away. If you're playing one of the later releases, you can also use the normal Sprint function to do this!

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: This chest is in the third basement level of Istory Falls. From the northeastern entrance, follow the path to an intersection: go east from there to find this chest at the end.

entries.label: Chest 8
entries.guide: This chest is in the third basement level of Istory Falls. From the northeastern entrance, follow the path to an intersection, go southwest, then at a second intersection, go southwest again. The chest will be at the dead end here. The Reflect Ring inside has no stat bonuses, however it does give the wearer Auto-Reflect, which reflects the majority of spells and magic attacks (but won't do anything against physical attacks).

entries.label: Chest 9
entries.guide: This chest is in the fourth basement level of Istory Falls. You can find it in the lower area in the southwestern corner of the room.

entries.label: Chest 10
entries.guide: This chest is in the fourth basement level of Istory Falls, which has several exits. Take the middle-most exit to appear in a small room with chest chest on the north wall. The item inside is Artemis's Bow, the second-most powerful bow in the game with 111 Attack, with a perk of 100% critical hit rates when used against Beasts. As a bow it can only be used by Rangers or Freelancers with the Equip Bows ability.

entries.label: Chest 11
entries.guide: This chest is in the fourth basement level of Istory Falls, which has several exits. Take the northwestern exit to appear back on B3, with this chest directly ahead. The item inside is Enhancer, the most powerful Sword in the game with 102 Attack (and +3 Magic).

entries.label: Chest 12
entries.guide: This chest is on the open fifth basement level of Istory Falls, and is on the western wall of the main room. You'll want to open it from the South, or else a crystal will rise up from the floor and stab you, dealing a huge amount of damage! You can use the nearby skull switch to raise the crystals in advance to avoid them. The item inside is an Aegis Shield that gives +33 Defense. Its perk is a 33% chance of blacking magic attacks, and making the wielder immune to Petrify.

entries.label: Chest 13
entries.guide: This chest is on the open fifth basement level of Istory Falls, and is in the northeastern part of the main room. You'll want to open it from the South, or else a crystal will rise up from the floor and stab you, dealing a huge amount of damage! You can use the nearby skull switch to raise the crystals in advance to avoid them.

entries.label: Chest 14
entries.guide: This chest is on the open fifth basement level of Istory Falls, and is in a southern side room. To get to it, you'll have to use the nearby skull switch to retract the crystal spikes. Head around the two holes and open the chest from the South: any other direction and the spikes will rise up and stab you for a huge amount of damage! The item inside is Titan's Axe, the second-most powerful Axe in the game with 91 Attack. As an Axe, it can only be wielded by Berserkers and Freelancers.

entries.label: Item 1
entries.guide: The one item in Istory Falls is a bit of a walk to get to, in a rather literal sense. You'll have to use Boko, Bartz's yellow chocobo from the start of the game, to get to the top of Istory Falls on the World Map. Assuming you having ridden him elsewhere after arriving in World 3, Boko is usually found outside Ghido's Cave, which is on the northeastern side of the central body of water on the map. From there you'll have get to Istory Falls. We have a route outlined on the map above, or you can follow the instructions below: The Magic Lamp is an incredibly unique item: every time it's used, it will use a Summon, with each one being of decreasing power until it gets to Chocobo, and then eventually "Eggman" who has no effect at all. It can be reset by returning to this spot in Istory Falls, or in the area where you fought the bosses Phobos, Triton and Nereid in the Great Sea Trench.

locations.name: Interdimensional Rift - Part 1
missables: Tinklebell drops from Twintania; Titan's Gloves and Thief's Gloves are stolen here, along with the Elven Mantle, Genji Shield and Genji Armor.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: The first chest of the Interdimensional Rift is in the room after you go down the chains. From the northern entrance of this room, head southwest to find it at the dead end.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: The second chest of the Interdimensional Rift is in the room after you go down the chains. From the northern entrance of this room, head southeast to find it at the dead end.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: The third chest of the Interdimensional Rift is in the room after you go down the chains. From the northern entrance of this room, head south to the bottom of the area: the chest will be to your left next to a pair of spinning wheels.

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: The fourth chest of the Interdimensional Rift is in the room after you go down the chains. From the northern entrance of this room, head south to the bottom of the area: the chest will be to your right next to a pair of spinning wheels.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: The fifth chest of the Interdimensional Rift is in the room with multiple chains to ride up and down. At the eastern side of the room, you'll have three sets of chains to choose from: pick the right-hand chains to get up to a platform with this chest on it.

entries.label: Chest 6
entries.guide: The sixth chest in the ruins is in the room just after the one with multiple chains. At the southern split near the entryway, take the right-hand path to find this chest at the end.

entries.label: Chest 7
entries.guide: This chest is the first one you can find in the Forest area of the Interdimensional Rift, but is not tracked in the Pixel Remaster. From the southwestern entrance, head east past the tree, then north up the path to a second tree. Look for the short side-path to the northeast of this tree to find the chest at the end.

entries.label: Chest 8
entries.guide: This chest is the second one you can find in the Forest area of the Interdimensional Rift, and is in the large clearing on the eastern side of the map with many large trees. Around the middle of this area are three trees in a row: this chest is at the base of the middle one.

entries.label: Chest 9
entries.guide: This chest is the third you can find in the Forest area of the Interdimensional Rift, and is in the large clearing on the eastern side of the map with many large trees. The one you're looking for is the eastern-most tree of the clearing, and is north of the tree with the exit door in the southeast corner of the map. The item inside is the Lilith Rod, which gives +3 Magic. Instead of dealing damage, it uses Flirt to cast Charm on the target that has a change to make it to miss a turn, and has a 25% change of using Osmose that leeches MP from the target to the user.

entries.label: Chest 10
entries.guide: This chest is the fourth that you can find in the Forest area of the Interdimensional Rift, and is in the large clearing on the eastern side of the map with many large trees. It will be at the base of the southern-most tree of the clearing, and west of the tree with the exit door in the southeast corner of the map.

entries.label: Chest 11
entries.guide: This chest is the first that can be found in the Cave area of the Interdimensional Rift. When you get to the main waterfall cliffs area, head east all the way to the end and then go north through the waterfall. You'll enter a hidden room, with this chest in the northeastern corner. The item inside is an Angel Ring, which protects the wearer against the Old and Zombie status effects.

entries.label: Chest 12
entries.guide: This chest is the second that can be found in the Cave area of the Interdimensional Rift. When you get to the main waterfall cliffs area, head east and go through the doorway you come across. You'll appear in a small side room, with this chest visible directly ahead up some stairs on the right. The item inside is a Coral Ring, which absorbs Water-based damage into health and negates all Fire damage, but makes the wearer weak to Lightning damage.

locations.name: The Rift
missables: Optional fights: Magic Pot (feed it an Elixir), Mover, Omega and Shinryu.

entries.label: Chest 1
entries.guide: This Chest is the first that can be found in The Rift, which is the castle area inside the Interdimensional Rift. After navigating the hidden paths of the floating castle platforms, you'll arrive at a central courtyard area and then enter inside of a lobby area with multiple exits. From the lobby's southern entry, head west to the end of the corridor and then south through the door. You'll emerge back outside and then enter a tower, with this chest inside. The item inside is Thor's Hammer, the most powerful Hammer in the entire game with 81 Attack. It also has the Long Range perk, which gives it more power if the wielder is placed in the back row of the party's battle formation. As an Axe, it can only be used by Berserkers and Freelancers.

entries.label: Chest 2
entries.guide: This Chest is the second that can be found in The Rift, which is the castle area inside the Interdimensional Rift. After navigating the hidden paths of the floating castle platforms, you'll arrive at a central courtyard area and then enter inside of a lobby area with multiple exits. From the lobby's southern entry, head east to the end of the corridor and then south through the door. You'll emerge back outside and then enter a tower, with this chest inside. The item inside is Hermes Sandals that grant the user Auto-Haste, meaning they are immune to the Slow, Stop, Paralyze and Sleep spells.

entries.label: Chest 3
entries.guide: This Chest is the third that can be found in The Rift, which is the castle area inside the Interdimensional Rift. After navigating the hidden paths of the floating castle platforms, you'll arrive at a central courtyard area and then enter inside of a lobby area with multiple exits. Head to the northern side of the lobby and then go south down the stairs to enter the Dungeon. To your right is a cell with three old men, who are actually Alte Roite enemies. These have a whopping 6,000 HP and will turn into a Jura Aevis when it runs out, who is even worse with 15,000 HP . Defeat / avoid them, and you can get to this chest in the northwest corner of the cell. The Red Slippers (likely a Wizard of Oz reference) can be worn by all classes as it gives immunity to Confusion. However on a Dancer or Freelancer, they increase the success of the Flirt move, and replaces the Tempting Tango with Sword Dance (which effectively increases its chances to 50%).

entries.label: Chest 4
entries.guide: This Chest is the fourth that can be found in The Rift, which is the castle area inside the Interdimensional Rift. After navigating the hidden paths of the floating castle platforms, you'll arrive at a central courtyard area and then enter inside of a lobby area with multiple exits. Head to the northern side of the lobby and then go south down the stairs to enter the Dungeon. In the southwest corner is a cell with three old men, who are actually Alte Roite enemies. These have a whopping 6,000 HP and will turn into a Jura Aevis when it runs out, who is even worse with 15,000 HP . Defeat / avoid them, and you can get to this chest in the northwest corner of the cell. The Rainbow Dress inside can only be equipped by Dancers and Freelancers, since it's a Robe. It increases the success rate of Flirt, and replaces Tempting Tango with Sword Dance, which effectively increases Tango's chances of being used to 50%. Lastly, the wearer will be immune to Confusion.

entries.label: Chest 5
entries.guide: This Chest is the fourth that can be found in The Rift, which is the castle area inside the Interdimensional Rift. It's in the Dungeon, the same place where Chests 14 and 15 are. To access it, you'll need to enter the north-eastern cell of the dungeon, but this will likely force you to face the Catastrophe boss. Once done, head up the stairs in the cell to get back outside. Go right and up some more stairs to get to an upper level. Here, cross west all the way to the opposite side and go down the stairs. Keep going down and you'll emerge in the northwestern cell of the Dungeon, with this chest ripe for looting! The chest contains Man-Eater, the most powerful Knife in the non-Mobile versions of the game with 89 Attack. However, it can only be equipped by Dancers and Freelancers. When used on a human target, it always lands with a Critical Hit, and the Knife has double damage when used with the Jump command.

entries.label: Chest 13
entries.guide: This chest is the first one found in the Final Floor, the floating islands of crystal in the Interdimensional Rift. Right when you arrive, head south down the stairs and you'll find it on your right. The item inside is a Fuma Shuriken, an item that deals a megaton 25,000 damage to a single target. It's used with the Throw command, meaning only Ninjas or jobs given the Throw ability can use it.

entries.label: Chest 14
entries.guide: This chest is the second found in the Final Floor, the floating islands of crystal in the Interdimensional Rift. After defeating the first boss in the first area, use the glowing circle to get to the second area. Here, go up the stairs, right, then down the first set of stairs. The chest will be here on the right.

entries.label: Chest 15
entries.guide: This chest is the third found in the Final Floor, the floating islands of crystal in the Interdimensional Rift. After defeating the first boss in the first area, use the glowing circle to get to the second area and get to the next glowing circle at the end. Instead of using it, head south down an extra flight of stairs to find this chest at the bottom.
